# arXiv:2503.04077v1 [math.SG] 6 Mar 2025

Periodic Inscription of Isosceles Trapezoids

Ali Naseri Sadr

Abstract

We prove that a pair of continuous disjoint periodic curves in C inscribes an isosceles trapezoid with any similarity type. The case of smooth curves can be identified with a Lagrangian intersection problem for a pair of Lagrangian cylinders in R × S' × C, and the continuous case follows from the smooth one by a standard convergence argument.

For any given isosceles trapezoid Q, we show there are four points in 71(R) U 12(R) that are vertices of a quadrilateral similar to Q. The approach of [5] does not directly generalize even to the case of rectangles.
